defs.meaning: 收缩（shrink 的过去式）；缩小

examples.en: My sweater shrank in the wash.
People were short in those days – or else those military uniforms all shrank in the wash!
examples.zh: 那个年代人们很矮–要么就是那些军装在洗涤时全都缩水了！

examples.en: Astrogeologists suspect that these scarps having formed billions of years ago as the planet's surface cooled and shrank.
examples.zh: 太空地质学家猜测这些陡坡是在几十亿年前当行星表面冷却收缩时开始形成的。
